editorial_review.scope: All 38 LSG verses aligned then reread against native Hebrew by lemma and French occurrence.
notes: Gen 42:1–20: grain, espionage, oath and custody idioms.
Gen 42:21–32: grouped distress, speech, kinship and silver expressions.
Gen 42:33–34: LSG includes the opening clause of native verse 34 at the end of verse 33; native IDs are preserved and linked to the actual French occurrence.
Gen 42:35–38: loss of children and mourning idioms; supplied proper names and contextual wording distinguished.
editorial_review.limitations: Both editorial passes by same editor; no independent audit or dictionary-sense verification. Publication checks deferred.
